content: Period columns: 반기보고서/분기보고서 income statements show both a 3-month column (3개월) and a cumulative column (누적). For a single-quarter question (e.g. 2분기 4~6월), copy the 3-month column of the 당기 period, not 누적 and not 전기. Final basis: if list_docs shows a [정정] filing or a later filing for the same period, use it instead of the original or a preliminary (잠정) figure. Check the unit line of the same table before converting (천원 → 억원 divide by 100,000; 백만원 → 억원 divide by 100), then round as asked.

Order for DART figure questions: list_docs, check for [정정], read the table, confirm the period column and unit, upsert the value with unit, compute the conversion once, then finalize immediately with the rounded result citing that evidence. Never repeat an identical compute; a repeated result means it is time to answer.
